headline.claim: no run dips below MASE 1.0 on the frozen test window (the naive floor itself scores 1.310 there — the scale is its in-sample error from a quieter period); lgbm_tuned is closest at MASE 1.076

band.note: coverages are empirical out-of-fold; the catalog band is the committed quantile p10/p90 backtest (h=1 per origin), replayed per origin on the same fold train windows

models.selection_rule: champion = committed _meta.best_model — lowest pooled MAE over the selection folds (origins 1..n-1) of the committed expanding-window backtest (evaluate.py); challenger = the committed test-window rank-2 non-naive model (runner-up to the champion on the frozen test window, by headline MAE); the final holdout window is scored once and never read for selection; 'global' = the same single pooled model serves every series (one-hot series_id); the naive floor is the weekly seasonal naive

feature_schema.note: calendar + lag features only — every feature is computable before day t (leakage-safe shifts)

evaluation_metadata.holdout_designation: last origin = test; selection used origins 1..n-1 only
evaluation_metadata.selection_rule: champion (best_model) = lowest pooled MAE over origins 1..n-1; all candidates are then scored exactly once on the test window and those are the committed headline metrics
evaluation_metadata.preprocessing_statement: Feature engineering uses shift-only lags and deterministic calendar encodings (no statistic is estimated on future rows); every model, the ridge StandardScaler, the MASE seasonal denominator and the conformal calibration widths are fit within the training window of each fold; the test window is scored once and never read for selection

metric_definitions.mae: mean |actual - forecast| over the test window (all series pooled)
metric_definitions.rmse: root mean squared error over the test window
metric_definitions.mape_pct: mean absolute percentage error over non-zero actuals only, in % — inflated by near-zero demand on intermittent series; not decision-grade
metric_definitions.mase: MAE scaled by the per-series in-sample seasonal-naive-7 error of the test fold's training window; < 1 beats 'same day last week'
metric_definitions.bias: mean(forecast - actual) over the test window — systematic over- or under-forecasting
metric_definitions.wape: sum|actual - forecast| / sum|actual| over the test window (weighted absolute percentage error; null when the denominator is 0)
metric_definitions.fold_maes: per-fold pooled MAE, folds 1..n (fold n is the test window)
metric_definitions.fold_mae_std: population std of fold_maes across all folds
metric_definitions.fold_mae_range: max - min of fold_maes across all folds
metric_definitions.horizon_mae: per-horizon (h=1..14) mean |error| over the final 14 days of the test window, pooled over series
metric_definitions.horizon_mase: per-horizon (h=1..14) mean |error|/seasonal scale over the final 14 days of the test window
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_mae: pre-holdout headline: pooled MAE over ALL folds (selection + test), kept for comparison
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_rmse: pre-holdout headline: pooled RMSE over all folds
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_mape_pct: pre-holdout headline: pooled MAPE over all folds
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_mase: pre-holdout headline: pooled MASE over all folds

multi_horizon.track: multi_step (primary); the top-level rolling_origin_holdout_v1 keys describe the retained frozen nowcast track

origins.cap_note: weekly origins, capped at 20 by dropping the oldest (exact weekly cadence kept) for runtime; the window starts the day AFTER the origin (no embargo gap)

multi_horizon.holdout_designation: last 4 origins = test (scored once); the earlier origins select (routing + conformal calibration) only
multi_horizon.selection_rule: per-series routing method = lowest summed |error| over the selection origins among zero/seasonal_naive/Croston/SBA/TSB; never reads test actuals (property-tested by shuffling the test origins' actuals)
multi_horizon.feature_semantics: direct per-horizon models: calendar of the target date + lags lag_h, lag_{h+7}, lag_{h+14} (>= h days old relative to the target — no actual within h days of the target is referenced); training rows use targets <= the origin only
multi_horizon.uncertainty: per-horizon split-conformal (learner rows) and P(sale)+quantile ladder (sparse rows), both calibrated on selection origins

metric_definitions.mae: mean |actual - forecast| over series x scored test origins at horizon h
metric_definitions.mase: pooled |err| / pooled per-series in-sample seasonal-naive-7 scale (zero-scale rows excluded)
metric_definitions.rmsse: M5-style: per-series sqrt(MSE(err)/MSE(in-sample seasonal-naive-7)), averaged over series (zero-scale excluded)
metric_definitions.pinball_pXX: mean pinball loss of the learner quantile at level XX
metric_definitions.coverage: share of actuals inside the per-h band on the scored origins
metric_definitions.calibration_verdict: |coverage - target| <= 0.05 -> calibrated; above -> conservative; below -> optimistic

evaluation_metadata.target_definition: The forecast target is the next 14 days of daily units per country-product series (top 8 countries x top 200 products by volume), aggregated from cleaned Online Retail II transactions (cancellations removed).

source.license: free for research (Chen, Gallino & Li 2012, Management Science)

dataset_metadata.cancellation_filtering: Sales lines only: rows with Quantity > 0 are kept; cancellations and returns (negative-quantity lines) are removed — returns are a separate business process and net-of-returns demand would double-count reverse logistics. Blank stock codes are dropped.
dataset_metadata.quantity_handling: Daily sum of line Quantity per (date, country, stock_code); the panel's 'units' column is that daily total (integer). 'price' is the mean line price of the day (carried for reference, not a model target).
dataset_metadata.geography: Top 8 countries by total unit volume are kept as 'stores'; all other countries are dropped.
dataset_metadata.products: Top 200 stock codes by total unit volume are kept as 'products'; the rest are dropped.
dataset_metadata.daily_aggregation: Transactions are aggregated to one row per (date, country, stock_code); the panel is reindexed to the complete daily calendar between the first and last observed dates, and missing day-series combinations are zero-filled (forward-filled price, 0 where never observed).
dataset_metadata.zero_sales_caveat: Zero-sales days may be missing rather than true zero demand: the source has no trading calendar, so a zero-filled day can mean 'closed or not trading' as easily as 'no demand'.
dataset_metadata.target_definition: The forecast target is the next 14 days of daily units per country-product series (top 8 countries x top 200 products by volume), aggregated from cleaned Online Retail II transactions (cancellations removed).

intermittency.method: Syntetos-Boylan quadrants: ADI (avg inter-demand interval) vs CV^2 (squared coefficient of variation) over each series' full history
intermittency.routing_rule: multi-step track: ADI >= 1.32 (intermittent + lumpy) series route to the best statistical method chosen on the selection origins only; smooth/erratic series use the direct per-horizon boosted model
